review_candidates.title: Area Veterinary Nurse - Essex
review_candidates.description: At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners. Are you looking for a role that combines variety, flexibility, and the opportunity to deliver exceptional nursing care across practices in your local area? We are seeking a confident RVN to join inspiring vet care on a full-time basis as an Area Veterinary Nurse, working clinically across a bespoke network of practices centred around your home location. This is a fixed-term contract expected to last 12 months, with real potential to become a permanent opportunity for the right person. The role focuses on flexibly delivering high-quality general nursing care and ensuring our teams are fully supported during busy periods, staff absence, or increased clinical demand. Working across multiple practices brings both variety and reward, with each site offering its own team, caseload, and way of working. This makes the role well-suited to a confident and adaptable nurse who enjoys meeting new people, integrating quickly into different environments, and contributing positively wherever they are based. You will work with 6-8 local brands regularly, as well as providing occasional cover in other sites if and when needed. Reporting to the Area Director, the role covers a designated region around Essex, depending on practice need. With some flexibility on these locations based on operational requirements and commuting capacity. As part of the role, you'll receive a £375 monthly car allowance to support travel across your designated practice area, which will generally be a maximum commute of 75mins, but often much less, depending on your home location. How You’ll Make a Difference As an Area Veterinary Nurse, you will be an integral member of the clinical team, delivering high-quality nursing care to patients while supporting excellent client experiences. You’ll work collaboratively with veterinary surgeons and the wider inspiring vet care team, taking responsibility for the nursing care of a range of first opinion cases, contributing to clinical standards, and supporting the ongoing development of patient care across our practices. This is ideally a full-time role working 40 hours per week over 4 or 5 days per week at your preference. The role doesn’t have any regular weekend or OOHs work but may include occasional weekend or bank holiday cover if needed, which would be compensated with TOIL. We can also consider a flexible shift pattern as well as part-time shifts for the right person. General Responsibilities Include Admit and discharge patients for routine procedures and deliver outstanding nursing care at all times. Run nurse clinics and provide accurate advice to clients on preventative healthcare, products, and practice policies. Assist veterinary surgeons with surgical procedures, anaesthetic monitoring, diagnostics, laboratory work, imaging, and inpatient care. Maintain accurate patient and client records, dispense repeat prescriptions, and support reception duties when required. Ensure all SOPs, Health & Safety regulations, and infection control procedures are followed across all nursing duties. Maintain high standards of cleanliness, equipment care, stock control, and clinical waste disposal throughout the practice. Support and train Student Veterinary Nurses and carry out Schedule Three procedures where appropriately trained and registered. Participate in rota commitments, stock takes, appraisals, and general practice support duties as required. You Might Be a Great Fit If... We’re Looking For a Confident And Motivated Area Veterinary Nurse Who Enjoys Working As Part Of a Team And Delivering High Standards Of Care. You’ll Bring Registration as a Veterinary Nurse with the RCVS Experience working in clinical practice, with growing confidence in medical and surgical nursing Strong communication skills and the ability to build positive relationships with clients and colleagues Good organisational skills and the ability to manage workload effectively A proactive approach to learning, reflection, and continuous improvement An enthusiasm for working dynamically across multiple practices How We’ll Support You At inspiring vet care, we’re committed to supporting your ongoing development and wellbeing. When you join us, you’ll benefit from: A varied and rewarding nursing role within a supportive primary care environment Graduate: Join a dedicated Nurse Graduate Programme designed to build your clinical confidence and support your first steps in practice Experienced: Develop your specific nursing passions through out subject-specific learning pathways in our dedicated Nurse Academy Clear career development with progression opportunities into Senior Nurse, Referral, leadership roles, clinical supervisor routes, mentoring and certificate pathways Ongoing learning and development supported by experienced colleagues and practice teams A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, community, and continuous improvement What We Offer Our Team 6.6 weeks' annual leave plus your birthday off Increasing holiday allowance based on length of service Enhanced family-friendly policies, including maternity/paternity/adoption/shared parental and surrogacy pay Private Medical Insurance Employee wellbeing initiatives including - Healthcare Cash Plan and Cycle to Work scheme £550 CPD allowance plus 24hrs paid leave Certificate support RCVS and VDS fees covered Pension scheme Discounted veterinary care Voluntary benefits: choose from a range of benefits to suit you - including Green Cars salary sacrifice scheme and access to discounts/cashback with hundreds of participating retailers We’re committed to supporting our people through career development opportunities, wellbeing initiatives and access to world-class learning resources. Whether you’re just starting out or looking to take the next step in your career, inspiring vet care offers the support, opportunity and community to help you grow. £0 - £0 a year Up to £35,000 DOE + £375 car allowance per month We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

review_candidates.title: Analyst, Finance and Capital Markets - Battery Storage
review_candidates.description: Company Overview Plus Power is an energy storage market leader, with a market-leading 10+ GW portfolio across more than 25 states that will transform North American electric grids into cleaner and more versatile critical infrastructure. Standalone energy storage is rapidly transforming the North American energy markets, because it is cheaper than new natural gas plants, faster to build than fossil peakers or transmission, and able to perform diverse energy services. Plus Power partners with electricity system operators, utilities, and investors to originate, develop, finance, own and operate standalone energy storage projects that provide critical services to the wholesale electric market. Plus Power's team applies an intentional mindset to energy storage development by using a data-driven approach to development and operations. At Plus Power, we are focused on solving hard climate problems, profitably. We are growing fast, and value candidates who, like us, share a focus on setting high expectations, owning and learning from mistakes in the spirit of radical transparency, and are committed to internal partnering as a key element of our ideas meritocracy. Our team praises Plus Power's culture and excels through our game-changing mission and supportive ecosystem. About the Role Plus Power is looking to hire a Finance and Capital Markets Analyst to join the company's finance team. This individual will support all aspects of project finance transactions for Plus Power's battery storage projects including construction financing, term debt/back-leverage and tax equity. Key responsibilities include creating and managing complex financial models, supporting the due diligence process, project management of financing deliverables, and coordinating with external financing parties to support the closing and funding of transactions. In addition, you will assist the finance team in bidding and structuring offtake agreements and executing on project acquisitions and project sales. This individual will get broad exposure to all aspects of the energy storage development and financing process and will collaborate with all functional teams across the company. This role includes significant responsibilities and room for growth within the company. Key Responsibilities Transaction Support: Support all aspects of debt and tax equity financing transactions, including preparation of marketing materials, due diligence, management of external consultants, and financial modeling. Project Modeling: Own all aspects of project financial models throughout the project lifecycle, including development, construction and operations. Modeling activities include project optimization, offtake bidding, and sourcing and vetting model inputs with experts in various groups across the company (Development, Interconnection, Markets, EPC, Origination, Asset Management). Data Analytics & Tools : Support the creation of dashboards, reports, and analytics to support senior management decision making and reporting to corporate investors Market Analysis: Analyze macroeconomic and ISO-level trends, including impacts of tax law changes, interest rate environments, and broader sector trends, and their effect on the viability of the company's portfolio. Cross-Functional Support and Collaboration: Collaborate with other teams within Plus Power to perform economic analysis and support key business decisions, including PPA pricing, optimization of project design, major equipment selection and O&M contract negotiation. Skills & Qualifications Minimum Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering or related field 1-2 years of project finance transaction experience at a developer, investment bank, project finance lender, tax equity investor, or infrastructure investor; OR finance/technical degree from a rigorous undergraduate program and completion of (or willingness to complete) a financial modeling course Proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite, especially Microsoft Excel, including experience with project financial modeling Tax equity modeling experience a plus Specific experience in energy storage, renewables, or gas a plus Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively and effectively in a cross-functional environment with team members who are geographically dispersed Highly organized with impeccable attention to detail Experience managing large projects with multiple stakeholders on tight timelines Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill and present complex information clearly and succinctly to internal and external stakeholders, including financing counterparties. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build positive working relationships and interact effectively with individuals across a range of roles, seniority levels, and working styles Ability and desire to learn and take on responsibility quickly Location flexible with a preference for candidates based in or near San Francisco, Chicago, Brooklyn, or Seattle (where other finance team members are based) Compensation, Location, and Benefits Highly competitive total compensation from one of North America's leading energy storage developers, owners, and operators, along with market-leading health benefits, 401(k) match, generous paid parental leave, flexible time off, work from home stipend, and other programs designed to support employees and their families. Flexible work arrangements include work-from-home or hybrid options from Plus Power's offices in The Woodlands, San Francisco, Chicago, Seattle, Brooklyn, Denver, Palm Beach Gardens, and Birmingham. While we are a remote-first company, we also have a highly engaged and connected culture, with opportunities to come together for in-person connection, professional development, and continued learning and growth. The expected salary range* for this position begins at $105,000. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range based on several factors including, but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, geographic labor market, and other factors consistent with applicable law. This position is also eligible to participate in our annual bonus program. The deadline* for applying to this role is 11/12/2026. Plus Power is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds can thrive. Plus Power is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. This information is provided in accordance with applicable law.

review_candidates.title: Vice President, Marketing - Stadiums
review_candidates.description: THE ROLE: Vice President, Marketing - Stadiums LOCATION: Remote - USA About Legends Global Legends Global is the premier partner to the world’s greatest live events, venues, and brands. We deliver a fully integrated suite of premium services through a white-label model that keeps our partners front and center — from feasibility and project development to sales, partnerships, hospitality, merchandise, venue management, and world-class content and booking. With a global network of more than 450 venues, hosting 20,000 events and welcoming 165 million guests annually, Legends Global brings unmatched scale, expertise, and connectivity to help our partners grow. The Legends Global Way guides how we operate: Align, Scale, Connect, Team, Win — shared success, repeatable systems, connected solutions, unstoppable teams, and wins that are earned every day. About The Role The Vice President, Marketing - Stadiums owns revenue-focused marketing strategy for the stadium venues within their portfolio, spanning ticket sales, premium seating and experiences, private events, hospitality, merchandise, and other revenue-generating lines of business. The role sets the standards, strategy, and performance expectations that venue-level Marketing teams execute locally, with scope covering digital and traditional marketing strategy, external communications strategy, creative direction, and partner integration - all in service of high-level portfolio performance and consistent alignment to Legends Global Marketing Network standards of excellence. This position reports to the SVP, Venue Marketing, and serves as the senior marketing leader for the venues in their portfolio, directing and coaching venue-level marketing leaders toward consistent, revenue-driving execution, developing talent, and serving as the escalation point for complex promoter, client, and cross-functional matters. Responsibilities may shift dynamically through technology and AI integrations. What You’ll Do (key Responsibilities & Outcomes) Elevate marketing performance across the portfolio through best-practice sharing, skill development, and mentorship of venue marketing teams - with revenue growth as the measure of success. Provide KPIs, benchmarks, and quarterly business performance reviews to venue leadership that translate key metrics directly into revenue-focused growth priorities. Tailor strategic marketing support by venue type, market, contract type, and event genre to maximize local revenue performance. Connect venue teams to Home Office specialists in premium seating, private events, and hospitality to build revenue-generating campaigns across non-ticketed lines of business. Provide budget planning templates, benchmark spend guidance, and vendor proposal/contract auditing support to drive the strongest possible return on marketing investment. Evaluate, pilot, and champion emerging marketing technologies and AI driven tools to enhance venue team capabilities, improved operational efficiencies, and unlock new revenue opportunities. Build and maintain operational and technical playbooks that give venue teams repeatable, revenue-focused frameworks to scale revenue-driving efficiency across the network. Own national promoter marketing relationships, monitoring and escalating priorities to protect revenue and the relationship. Direct tour-wide marketing strategy and activations, measuring performance across venues to drive ticket sales from one tour stop to the next. Provide benchmark ticket sales pacing data and self-service marketing intelligence tools and dashboards that enable venue teams to make data-informed, revenue-driving decisions. Provide onboarding, documentation, and self-service learning resources to drive tool adoption and consistent, revenue-focused execution. Offer webinars, office hours, and targeted sessions for new initiatives and system enhancements. Partner with venue management leaders and HR to attract, evaluate, and hire top marketing talent; provide input on organizational structure and marketing's roles to ensure venues are resourced appropriately. Mentor and directly develop Directors of Marketing and other marketing team members across the portfolio. Identify and facilitate partner and vendor-led trainings to keep venue teams ahead of the curve. Commit to ongoing professional development by staying active across industry trends, emerging technologies, and evolving marketing best practices. What You Bring (qualifications & Experience) EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent in marketing or related field 10+ years of marketing experience Previous experience in a marketing role at a stadium venue is required Experience marketing or supporting large-scale, high-profile events and sporting tenants (e.g., NFL, Super Bowl, College Football Playoff, major concert tours, or other tentpole events) strongly preferred. Skills And Abilities Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop marketing leaders across a multi-venue portfolio Ability to work in a team-oriented environment and effectively influence and communicate with C-level clients and senior stakeholders Professional verbal and written communication skills Candidates should possess excellent time management, strong work ethic, and organizational skills Proficient in Microsoft Office, with a focus on Word, Excel and PowerPoint Practice safe work habits, follow all safety policies and procedures and regulations, complete company-wide safety training and any additional job-specific safety training. KEY LEADERSHIP ATTRIBUTES Directly manages Directors of Marketing across the venues within their portfolio in partnership with venue management leaders, and in accordance with all Legends Global policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include support of hiring, training, and development of lead marketing team members; setting performance expectations and standards of excellence; supporting performance reviews; and addressing performance or personnel matters in partnership with venue management leaders Human Resources. WORK ENVIRONMENT & TRAVEL Remote Opportunity Travel up to 15% for departmental meetings, conferences, venue and client visits, promoter meetings, and industry events. At Legends Global, our people power every success. You’ll work alongside exceptional talent, learn from world-leading experts, and contribute to projects that set the standard across sports, entertainment, hospitality, and live experiences. If you’re driven to operate at the highest level, build with purpose, and help partners win on the biggest stages, you’ll thrive here. Compensation The salary range for this position is $150,000 - $160,000 commensurate with experience, skills, and qualifications. This role is also bonus eligible. Legends Global offers a competitive total rewards package, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, paid vacation, and 401k plan. Legends Global is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer, and encourages Women, Minorities, Individuals with Disabilities, and protected Veterans to apply. VEVRAA Federal Contractor.

review_candidates.title: Vale femme de chambre
review_candidates.description: Description de l'entreprise Hôpital de Cannes est un établissement de santé engagé à offrir des soins de qualité et un environnement sûr et propre pour les patient·es, les visiteur·euses et les professionnel·les. L’hôpital accorde une importance particulière à l’hygiène, au confort et au respect des personnes accueillies. Les équipes pluridisciplinaires travaillent en coopération pour garantir un accompagnement humain, attentif et professionnel. Rejoindre l’Hôpital de Cannes, c’est contribuer au bon fonctionnement d’un service public essentiel et à l’amélioration du quotidien des patient·es. Description du poste Le poste de valet / personne de chambre est à pourvoir à temps plein, sur site, à Paris. La personne recrutée assure la propreté et l’entretien des chambres, des sanitaires et des espaces communs, en respectant les protocoles d’hygiène hospitalière. Elle s’occupe de la collecte, du tri et de la gestion du linge (draps, serviettes, tenues), ainsi que de la mise en place des lits et du réassort des produits (savons, papier, consommables). Au quotidien, elle veille au confort des patient·es, répond à leurs demandes simples, signale les besoins spécifiques aux équipes soignantes et contribue à un accueil courtois et respectueux. Le poste implique un travail en équipe avec le personnel médical et hôtelier, ainsi que le respect des horaires et des consignes de sécurité. Qualifications Compétences en gestion du linge : expérience en blanchisserie, tri, pliage, distribution et entretien du linge hospitalier. Compétences en communication : capacité à échanger de manière claire et respectueuse avec les patient·es, les équipes soignantes et les collègues. Compétences en service aux personnes : sens du service, attitude bienveillante, écoute des besoins des patient·es et souci de leur confort. Compétences organisationnelles : rigueur, gestion des priorités, respect des procédures d’hygiène et des protocoles de nettoyage. Compétences en formation et apprentissage : capacité à suivre des formations internes (hygiène, sécurité, gestion du linge) et à appliquer les bonnes pratiques. Autres atouts : expérience préalable en milieu hospitalier ou hôtelier, résistance physique, ponctualité, discrétion, et maîtrise des bases du français écrit et oral.
